candidates.source_name: Zavod RS za zaposlovanje (ZRSZ / ESS) - official public vacancy register
candidates.why_relevant: The state employment service is where employers post vacancies free of charge; it is the most complete and least self-selected Slovenian vacancy set, and an RSS feed is referenced. Banks post here too, including roles they do not market on LinkedIn.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the eSvetovanje ad search and any RSS feed; filter by employer name (banka, hranilnica) and SKD financial-services activity codes

negative_findings.description: Bankart's careers page indicated no open vacancies at the time of search, although archived individual role pages (e.g. business analyst for payment-instrument processing IT services) exist.
negative_findings.result_summary: Vacancy pages for a key actor can be empty at any given moment; a single check produces a false 'no activity' read.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This cell's value depends on continuous time-series capture, not point-in-time snapshots. Empty today does not mean quiet.

negative_findings.description: Local-language queries containing 'razvojna banka' / 'banka' returned heavy noise from non-Slovenian institutions (Bosnian, Bulgarian development banks) and Wikipedia articles rather than SI job ads.
negative_findings.result_summary: Generic 'banka' terms are noisy across the ex-Yugoslav language space; queries must be pinned with SI-specific tokens (prosta delovna mesta, d.d., Ljubljana, .si domains).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Untuned local-language queries waste collection budget and can pull cross-border results into a SI-scoped dataset.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn (job search and company pages) is the richest source for named tech stacks and headcount build-out but is behind a login wall and its ToS prohibits automated collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: Unauthenticated LinkedIn shows only partial listings; no compliant automated pipeline exists without a licensed data feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The highest-signal source in this cell cannot be scraped; it needs either manual analyst review or a paid/licensed labour-market data provider.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated careers/vacancy URLs were confirmed in this pass for several relevant SI actors: Addiko Bank Slovenija, Gorenjska banka, Delavska hranilnica, Sberbank-successor entities, Banka Slovenije (central bank), and domestic fintechs/e-money issuers (e.g. mBills, Flik participants).
negative_findings.result_summary: Actor map is incomplete; these were named or implied in results but their own hiring pages were not located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Missing mid-tier banks and the central bank leaves a hole exactly where quieter modernisation programmes tend to sit.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language equivalents were found in this pass for vendor/programme jargon that job ads typically carry in English ('core banking migration', 'instant payments', 'ISO 20022', 'PSD2/PSD3 readiness'); SI ads appear to use the English terms verbatim.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-in-Slovenian is the working register for bank IT ads; SL-only queries will under-recall technical roles.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design must mix SL job-ad framing words with English technical tokens, or half the signal is invisible.

negative_findings.description: Job ads on SI portals and employer sites expire and are deleted, and no public archive of expired SI bank vacancies was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Signal is perishable; nothing found reconstructs historical hiring after the fact.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without own-archiving at discovery time, no trend analysis of headcount/skill shifts is possible retrospectively.

coverage_gaps.description: Careers endpoints missing for Addiko Bank Slovenija, Gorenjska banka, Delavska hranilnica, Banka Slovenije, Sparkasse/Steiermärkische SI, and SI savings banks (hranilnice).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated SL pass per actor: '<bank> kariera', '<bank> zaposlitev', '<bank> prosta delovna mesta', plus site: queries on each .si domain; register each found endpoint as a direct source.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment/fintech vendors and integrators serving SI banks (beyond Halcom and Bankart) are unmapped — e.g. Comtrade, Marand, Endava/Adacta-type integrators, e-money and PSP licensees registered with Banka Slovenije.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-reference the Banka Slovenije register of payment institutions/e-money issuers with job-portal employer pages, then add each vendor's careers page as a source; vendor hiring is a leading indicator of bank projects.

coverage_gaps.description: No archiving/snapshot strategy exists for ephemeral ads, and no check was made for RSS/JSON feeds or an API on ZRSZ, Optius or Zaposlitev.net.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe for RSS/XML feeds (ZRSZ RSS is referenced on its site) and stable pagination URLs; store full ad HTML + text at first sighting with first_seen/last_seen timestamps.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn — the best source for named stacks, seniority and headcount growth — is ToS/login-restricted, leaving no compliant automated route.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scope a licensed labour-market data provider covering SI, or define a manual weekly analyst review protocol with saved searches and structured note capture.

coverage_gaps.description: Adjacent hiring-signal channels were not explored: student-work agencies (študentski servis) which banks use for pilot teams, procurement/consulting-body-shop tenders, and internship/scholarship programmes (štipendije) that flag multi-year capability plans.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a discovery pass over študentsko delo portals and bank scholarship/internship pages in SL; these leak intent even earlier than permanent-role ads.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage relied largely on LinkedIn; international-group career portals (UniCredit group, Intesa Sanpaolo group, OTP group, Addiko group) that carry SI-located requisitions in EN were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map each parent group's global careers portal and filter by location=Slovenia; group portals often list SI roles that never appear on the local site.

brief: Slovenia's hiring-signal landscape for banking and payments rests on three layers: a small set of general SI job portals (MojeDelo, Optius, Zaposlitev.net) plus the state ZRSZ/ESS vacancy register, which together give near-complete but shallow coverage; employer-owned careers pages (NLB, OTP, Intesa Sanpaolo, Deželna banka) and — most valuable — the shared infrastructure and vendor players Bankart and Halcom, whose ads name the exact payment platforms and programmes being stood up sector-wide; and LinkedIn, which carries the richest stack and seniority detail but is login- and ToS-restricted, so it needs manual or licensed access rather than scraping. Optius is the best structured entry point because it exposes stable per-employer URLs for most Slovenian banks, and BetterCareer.si adds IT-specific depth. The dominant operational risk is ephemerality: ads are deleted on expiry and no public archive of past Slovenian bank vacancies was found, so all value depends on capturing and timestamping ad text at first sighting. Language-wise, SL framing words (prosta delovna mesta, zaposlitev, kariera, plačilni promet) must be combined with English technical tokens, which SI bank IT ads use verbatim.
